matchup.title: Matchup 2: Come-in Cider vs Team Nic Kerr
matchup.holding: Derrick Jones Jr. (LAC, 3 games next week).
matchup.plan_md:
We lead **755 to 734** after Wednesday. As rostered we project **1,486 to 1,672**. Paul Reed stays, as cover for Duren, so only McCollum's slot streams.

**The moves, 3 adds, +65.5** (*Rotating* section, 3-add row):

| # | US day | Deadline, Melbourne (ET) | Move |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Fri 30 | **10:30 am Sat 31** (7:30 pm Fri) | Drop McCollum after his Thursday game, add **Norman Powell** (CHI) |
| 2 | Sat 31 | **11:30 am Sun 1** (8:30 pm Sat) | Drop Powell, add **Isaiah Hartenstein** (OKC) |
| 3 | Sun 1 | **12:30 pm Mon 2** (8:30 pm Sun) | Drop Hartenstein, add **Derrick Jones Jr.** (LAC) |

- **McCollum plays Thursday at 8:00 pm ET (11:00 am Friday Melbourne) before the swap.** The 4-add version also streams Thursday, but gains only 1.1 more.
- **Cheaper options:**
  - 2 adds, +55.0: Friday McCollum → Grayson Allen, then Sunday Allen → Derrick Jones Jr.
  - 1 add, +32.9: Friday McCollum → Derrick Jones Jr.
- **Cost after this week:** McCollum has 4 games next week. Derrick Jones Jr., who we end the week holding, has 3.
- **With the plan:** our lineup adds +65.5, which still leaves us behind as projected.
- **What would swing it:**
  - **VanVleet** sits one game of Houston's Friday–Saturday back-to-back, per Udoka. If it's Saturday, our projection drops to 1,451 (a `--sit` run). Houston files its report by 1 p.m. CT, which is 5:00 am Sunday in Melbourne for Saturday's game.
  - **Luka Dončić** (theirs, back tightness): sat Wednesday; the Lakers hope he plays Friday; ESPN est. 30 Oct.
  - **Chet Holmgren** (theirs, patellar tendinitis): no timetable reported; ESPN est. 31 Oct. OKC plays Saturday, their 9-player day. His return would also cut Hartenstein's minutes.
  - **They have all 7 adds left** and 8 open slots on Sunday.
  - **Kawhi Leonard** (ours, left knee swelling): re-evaluated in one week from 27 Oct per the Raptors; ESPN est. 23 Nov.
  - **Jalen Duren** (ours, IR, right hamstring): out at least two weeks from 25 Oct; ESPN est. 9 Nov.
- **Lineups:** Friday has 9 of ours playing for 10 slots, and every other day has open slots. Start everyone with a game.

### Notes

- **Norman Powell** has started all 5 of Chicago's games (*Started* column). Chicago plays only Friday this week.
- **Hartenstein** "anchored" OKC's frontcourt with Holmgren out: 15 and 13 on 26 Oct, then 10 and 14 on 28 Oct [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/thunders-isaiah-hartenstein-double-doubles-in-win-536309/) [Yahoo Sports](https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/chet-holmgren-injury-okc-thunder-222229627.html).
- **Derrick Jones Jr.** starts for the Clippers, at 28–35 minutes, with Ingram and Strus out at least another week from 29 Oct and Beal without a timetable (ESPN est. 8 Nov for all three) [Basketnews](https://basketnews.com/news-258395-la-clippers-provide-new-huge-injury-updates-on-brandon-ingram-others.html) [SI](https://www.si.com/nba/clippers/onsi/clippers-injury-report-thunder-latest-brandon-ingram-bradley-beal-01m5t411kj1v).
- **VanVleet's rest:** Udoka confirmed he sits one game of each back-to-back early this season [Yahoo Sports](https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/fred-vanvleet-rests-marcus-smart-080047518.html).
- **Dončić:** back tightness, and the Lakers hope he plays Friday at Golden State [Heavy](https://heavy.com/sports/nba/los-angeles-lakers/jj-redick-luka-doncic-ziaire-williams-injury-update/).
- **Dybantsa claim:** ESPN's transaction log at 07:08 UTC shows Dr White Slong's claim executed, and ours and Cream Abdul-Yammar's failed.
